summary: How does the antiques industry work and is it accurately portrayed on television shows?
content:
Radio 4 , · 01 Oct 2026 , · 48 mins

If there’s one business that’s ingrained in popular culture, you could argue it's the buying and selling of antiques. You only have to count the number of TV shows where people find and flog something hoping for a profit to recognise the appeal. But how does the business really operate? Is it accurately portrayed on television and how do antiques come up for sale in the first place? Evan Davis is joined by a panel of experts to get some answers and asks whether anything we manufacture today will last long enough to be auctioned off in a hundred years-time. Guests: Catherine Southon: Catherine Southon Auctioneers and Valuers, TV expert on Flog It!, Bargain Hunt and Antiques Road Trip Mark Hill: Dealer, Author, Lecturer and TV expert on Antiques Road Show and Antiques Road Trip Conor Hannah: Founder of SellingAntiques.co.uk Presenter: Evan Davis Producers: Nick Holland & Sally Abrahams Sound: Dave O'Neill & Neil Churchill Production Coordinator: Katie Morrison Editor Matt Willis
chineseSummary: 古董行业是如何运作的？电视节目是否准确地描述了它？
chineseContent:
第 4 广播电台，·2026 年 10 月 1 日，·48 分钟

如果有一种行业根深蒂固于流行文化中，您可以说它就是古董买卖。你只需计算一下人们发现并推销一些希望盈利的电视节目的数量，就能认识到这种吸引力。但企业的实际运作情况如何呢？电视上的描述是否准确？古董最初是如何出售的？埃文·戴维斯 (Evan Davis) 与专家小组一起寻求答案，并询问我们今天制造的任何东西是否能持续足够长的时间，以便在一百年后被拍卖。嘉宾： 凯瑟琳·索森 (Catherine Southon)：凯瑟琳·索森 (Catherine Southon) 拍卖师和估价师、《Flog It!》、《讨价还价》和《古董公路旅行》电视专家 马克·希尔 (Mark Hill)：经销商、作家、古董路演和古董公路旅行讲师和电视专家 康纳·汉娜 (Conor Hannah)：SellingAntiques.co.uk 创始人 演讲者：埃文·戴维斯 (Evan Davis) 制作人：尼克·霍兰德 (Nick Holland) 和莎莉·亚伯拉罕 (Sally Abrahams) 声音：戴夫·奥尼尔 (Dave O'Neill) 和尼尔·丘吉尔 (Neil Churchill) 制作协调员：凯蒂·莫里森 编辑 马特·威利斯
